answer: Tested a prediction, 9 of 12 on the Button cases (e6ab7e0). A typed link under the mouse has no tip unless the row cuts it short; a long one has its address as a tip. An address that is no page, /nope, closes on Enter. The link button closes the field view too. Clear and a press on the page take the link as Escape does. Undo after Clear brings the link back, and lets the block go. Shift+Tab from the row goes to Remove Link. One Escape closes Edit's field. The panel's Attach link closes on a typed Enter too, focus on the panel's row.
ours: Missed: the long tip, Clear by a press on the page, built since. Named: after Undo the oracle's block lets go, ours stays selected, one read. The panel's focus isn't compared.
pressed: Named presses with an on-top check. Typing by real keys. Not by name, no on-top check: clickAt 138, 380 on the box's Edit, since Edit is also the toolbar's name, and clickAt 1300, 700 on the page; moveAt to hover; real clicks on blocks.
